purpose: Catalog of data sources; private project, licences are not tracked

releaseTarget.validation: Early Access sources require 1.0 validation; Act 5–6 rules are not yet established

constraints: Original authored text only; no images or third-party extracts
Validate objectives against target patch before shipping

sources.method: Offline collection of internal area IDs, scene names and observed levels from the owner's Client.txt
constraints: Factual observations only; original logs remain local
No character names, chat, server details or quest dialogue exported
Historical observations are not a current-patch authoritative zone table

sources.method: Contributor-authored abstract schematics from labelled observations of explored maps
constraints: Record author, patch, zone, observation and confidence for each diagram
Live automated capture remains subject to step 7

sources.method: Datamined from the local PoE 2 install with poe_data_tools (WorldAreas, Topologies, .tgr graphs)
constraints: Graphs give fixed points and corridors, not walls; walls are generated per instance
Which layout is being played must be recognised from the recorded path
